---

Canon ideas are raised as issues, not pull requests. Open `canon` issues are reviewed on the 3rd of each month. See `plans/canon-master-plan.md`, "Governance after December 1".

**What should Canon do that it does not do today?**
One or two sentences.

**Who needs it, and what goes wrong without it?**
A concrete example helps more than a general case.

**Which layer does it touch?**
- [ ] Governed data slices (alternate base views, queries)
- [ ] Concepts and authority (graph concepts, edges, tiers)
- [ ] Agent guardrails (canonical notes)
- [ ] Executable procedures (skills, actions, workflows)
- [ ] Schema (a new type, status, tier, edge type or column)

**What existing work is it related to?**
Link the section of the master plan, and any issue or pull request that overlaps.

**Rough size**
Small (days), medium (a sprint), or large (needs its own plan).
